table limit_usage
  engine SummingMergeTree(units) ORDER BY (merchant_id, customer_id, limit_key, window_starts_at) TTL toDateTime(ifNull(window_ends_at, window_starts_at)) + toIntervalDay(61) WHERE window_ends_at IS NOT NULL SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024

  column customer_id UUID
  column limit_key String

  column window_ends_at Nullable(DateTime64(6, 'UTC'))

table usage_days
  engine SummingMergeTree((requests, quantity, stated, charged, forgiven)) ORDER BY (merchant_id, customer_id, day, currency, event_type, meter, cell, invoker, outcome) TTL day + toIntervalMonth(25) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024

  column customer_id UUID
  column day Date
  column currency LowCardinality(String)
  column event_type LowCardinality(String)
  column meter LowCardinality(String)
  column cell String
  column invoker String
  column outcome Enum8('succeeded' = 1, 'failed' = 2)
  column requests UInt64
  column quantity Int64
  column stated Int64
  column charged Int64
  column forgiven Int64

materialized view usage_days_charges_mv TO {database}.usage_days
  SELECT merchant_id, customer_id, toDate(occurred_at, 'UTC') AS day, currency, event_type, charges.meter AS meter, charges.cell AS cell, invoker, outcome, toUInt64(1) AS requests, charges.quantity AS quantity, charges.stated AS stated, toInt64(0) AS charged, toInt64(0) AS forgiven FROM {database}.usage_events ARRAY JOIN charges

materialized view usage_days_events_mv TO {database}.usage_days
  SELECT merchant_id, customer_id, toDate(occurred_at, 'UTC') AS day, currency, event_type, '' AS meter, '' AS cell, invoker, outcome, toUInt64(1) AS requests, toInt64(0) AS quantity, ifNull(stated, 0) AS stated, charged, forgiven FROM {database}.usage_events

materialized view usage_minutes_mv TO {database}.usage_minutes
  SELECT merchant_id, customer_id, currency, toStartOfMinute(toDateTime(occurred_at, 'UTC')) AS minute, amount FROM {database}.usage_events
